articles.title: Bitcoin miners tied to AI rise as Nvidia posts big earnings beat and strong outlook
articles.snippet: Nvidia's stronger-than-expected results and bullish AI outlook lifted crypto mining stocks tied to data center and high-performance computing demand, even as the chipmaker's shares fell due to growth concerns.

articles.title: Syndicate Labs winds down after 5 years, citing shrinking rollup market
articles.snippet: The Ethereum rollup market is dominated by Arbitrum and Base, which have a combined 68% market share, according to L2Beat.

articles.title: Nvidia Beats, Stock Dumps—BofA Says Buy the Dip
articles.snippet: Record $81.6 billion in revenue for Nvidia—and yet the stock fell. Bank of America called the dip noise and raised its price target.
